description: The bar chart compares the runtime of different models in a streaming environment. The categories are listed on the horizontal axis, labeled with the names of the models: "Our Joint Framework", "ChatGPT", "DeepSeek", "LLaMA", and "Claude". The vertical axis is labeled "Runtime (seconds)" and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 400 seconds, with tick labels at intervals of 50 seconds. The bars represent the runtime of each model, with "Our Joint Framework" colored green and the other models, referred to as "LLM Models", colored light blue. The runtime values are 77 seconds for "Our Joint Framework", 190 seconds for "ChatGPT", 365 seconds for "DeepSeek", 172 seconds for "LLaMA", and 243 seconds for "Claude". The bars are not sorted in a specific order, and "Our Joint Framework" is visually distinguished by its green color.
